settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.body: Answers to everything before you have to DM Lami — grouped so you can find yours fast.

settings.question: What is GBG Wholesale Hub?
settings.answer: A UK wholesale hub that sells ready-stock products at low minimum order quantities, alongside the education and community to help you actually resell them.

settings.question: Who is Lami and why did she build this?
settings.answer: Lami started reselling with a small bridal accessories business in 2016 and built GBG to be the guide she wishes she'd had.

settings.question: Where is the warehouse based?
settings.answer: Every order ships from the UK. Exact warehouse location:

settings.question: Do I need to join the community to shop?
settings.answer: No. You can shop and check out directly with no account or community membership required.

settings.question: How much do I need to start?
settings.answer: There's no requirement to buy in bulk beyond each pack's stated MOQ.

settings.question: Can I choose my own sizes or designs?
settings.answer: Not on standard packs — wholesale stock is sold as-is. Specific sizes are sometimes available during live auctions.

settings.question: What's your returns and refund policy?
settings.answer: Damaged, faulty or incorrect items are always covered — tell us within 48 hours of delivery with photos and we'll replace or refund them in full. If you bought as a consumer rather than for a business, you also have 14 days to change your mind. Wholesale packs bought for resale are sold as-is once received in good condition. The full policy sets out every case.

settings.question: Can I reorder after my first purchase?
settings.answer: Yes, and once you've made your first purchase, you've automatically unlocked the GBG Wholesale Hub for restock alerts.

settings.question: Where should I sell GBG products?
settings.answer: Depends on the product and your audience — the Platform Guide breaks down what tends to move best on Vinted, eBay, TikTok Shop, and Facebook Marketplace.

settings.question: Why did my Vinted account get restricted?
settings.answer: Usually a listing pattern the algorithm flags as reselling at scale. Our Platform Safety Guide covers how to avoid it.

settings.question: How do I price my products?
settings.answer: Use our pricing calculator below: cost ÷ quantity, plus packaging and platform fees, gives you your minimum sell price.

settings.question: How do I write a listing that actually sells?
settings.answer: Clear photos, honest titles, and the right keywords for your platform.

settings.question: What is the Start Your Product Business group?
settings.answer: A free group for anyone still deciding — education and webinar access, no purchase required.

settings.question: What is the GBG Wholesale Hub community, and how do I get in?
settings.answer: It's for verified buyers, unlocked automatically after your first purchase.

settings.question: What is the Academy and how is it different from the community?
settings.answer: The Academy is a structured, paid programme with a fixed six-module curriculum and direct feedback on your own listings, prices and product choices. The communities are peers and alerts; the Academy is someone checking your actual work. Intakes are small, so you apply and we reply personally with dates and pricing.

settings.question: I've been scammed before. How do I know GBG is real?
settings.answer:
Fair question, and one we'd rather answer than have you wonder. Here's what you can actually check, rather than just taking our word for it:

  • Checkout runs on Shopify's own secure payment system. We never see or hold your card details, and you're covered by your card provider's protection.
  • Every product photo on this site is of stock we actually hold and ship from the UK — not supplier renders.
  • Lami answers questions personally, by name, on WhatsApp and inside the community. You can message her before you spend anything.
  • The community is public and active. You can join SYPB free, read what members are saying, and ask them directly about their orders before you buy from us.
  • Our returns policy is written out in full, including what we will and won't cover.

If you're still unsure, start with the smallest Starter Box. Risking a small first order and seeing how we handle it is a far better test than anything we could tell you here.
